About me

I am a Full Professor at the University of Cantabria and a member of the Advanced Signal Processing Group (GTAS in Spanish) in the Department of Communications Engineering (DICOM). My research interests include signal processing algorithms and information-theoretic aspects of multiuser multiantenna wireless communication systems, multivariate statistical techniques, and signal processing for inference, prediction, decision-making, and optimal design.

Research lines

  • Signal processing for single-user and multi-user MIMO wireless systems
  • Noncoherent communications based on Grassmannian signaling, and optimal packings on manifolds
  • Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces, including beyond-diagonal architectures
  • Interference management: interference alignment, improper signaling, NOMA and cognitive radio
  • Detection: multistatic passive radar and multiantenna detection
  • Convex, non-convex and manifold optimization
  • Machine learning: kernel methods and kernel adaptive filtering
  • Information theory and multivariate statistics, in particular canonical correlation analysis
  • Experimental evaluation of MIMO systems on over-the-air testbeds
